subject.title: fix(ai): record token usage on Responses early-abort (#100954)

question: Should this PR require a redacted live OpenAI/Azure `response.incomplete` before/after transcript, or should a maintainer explicitly override the external-PR real-behavior proof gate based on the exact-event regression coverage?
rationale: The code and dependency contract support the fix, but repository policy treats real after-fix behavior proof as a merge gate for external runtime PRs; only a maintainer can authorize an override.
